name: data-fixes-from-audit

metrics.cord_total: image key collision (validation+test both -> val as cord-val-i): ~100 val questions paired with wrong receipts; fixed (key by source split) + builder now fails on key collisions; rebuilt
metrics.openimages_count/oi_count: misleading counting wording for collective/plural classes (Stairs -> 1 staircase box vs steps); such classes excluded; rebuilt. Zero-shot openimages_count results logged before this fix used the old set
metrics.synth workflows: per-question yes/no rates 25-70% let question text predict the answer (question-only 0.71 vs prior 0.54); all conditions now 50%; rebuilt
metrics.banking77/clinc_intent/support_intent: random distractors let word overlap score 0.58-0.69 vs chance 0.18; half of distractors now hard negatives (share words with the text); rebuilt
metrics.textvqa: distractors are other questions answers (easy); no OCR tokens in the mirror to make hard negatives: known weakness, kept

notes: see results/experiments.jsonl audit records for the numbers

DISK=100; VOLUME=60

JEVBENCH=/home/kneepolean/shubhj/VisionJev/external/jevbench
MAX_HOURS=7
VERDICT_BASE=qwen4b-v6b3
VERDICT_NEW="qwen4b-v6b4 qwen4b-v6b4-soup50"
EVAL_RESERVE_MIN=75   # the trainer stops in time for the evals before the cap
